# Cowlendar

Cowlendar is a Shopify booking app operated by BOOKING APPOINTMENT COWLENDAR (SIREN 989 284 062), 14 rue Charles V, 75004 Paris, France.

## Product

Bookable Shopify services including appointments, group sessions, events, full-day and multi-day reservations. Integrations include Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Klaviyo; verify the exact setup with the documentation.

## Pricing checked September 22, 2026

- Free: 5 bookings/month, all features.
- Starter: $13.99/month, up to $1,000 booking revenue.
- Basic: $29.99/month, up to $3,000 booking revenue.
- Growth: $59.99/month, up to $10,000 booking revenue.

USD monthly prices. Verify current limits, taxes and usage charges on the official listing.
